style: Strictly black-and-white monochrome photograph, no color at all. Photorealistic live-action cinema, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lens, 2.39 feel inside 16:9, subtle organic film grain, deep inky blacks and bright silver highlights, dramatic natural chiaroscuro lighting, realistic motion blur, shallow depth of field. Avoid: color, text overlays, captions, logos, watermarks, holograms, glowing UI, floating documents, CGI look, distorted faces, extra fingers, warped hands, morphing objects, flicker, legible fake text.

shots.prompt: Night aerial drone tracking shot high above Lower Manhattan Financial District after rain. Wet streets shine with reflections, lit office windows across the skyline, thin atmospheric haze between towers. The camera glides forward and slowly descends toward a single black luxury sedan driving down a narrow wet canyon street between old stone skyscrapers.

Low tracking shot at street level at night, camera travelling alongside a black luxury sedan as it drives slowly through a wet Financial District street in Manhattan. Rain falls, streetlights and building lights reflect and ripple on the glossy car body and the puddled asphalt. Steam rises from a street grate.

1960s New York stock exchange trading floor, crowded with traders in white shirts, ties and jackets. Steadicam moves forward through the crowd at chest height. Traders hold telephone receivers, pass paper slips hand to hand, gesture and shout. Hanging lamps, slips of paper on the floor, high ornate ceiling.

Extreme macro close-up of a man's hand lifting the receiver of a heavy vintage rotary desk telephone from its cradle in one quick decisive motion. Cufflink and shirt cuff visible. Hard side light, black background.

Macro close-up of a vintage rotary newspaper printing press running at speed: large steel cylinders spinning, a continuous sheet of newsprint racing through the rollers, ink rollers turning. Camera slowly dollies along the machine. Industrial hard light, mechanical vibration.

Macro close-up of an antique brass stock ticker machine under a glass dome, its mechanism clattering as a thin paper tape feeds out and curls. Camera slowly pushes in. Single hard key light from the side.

Extreme close-up of a classic steel mechanical wristwatch on a man's wrist, the second hand sweeping, as the arm turns slightly toward camera. Shirt cuff, soft reflections on the crystal, dark background.

Night interior of a dark high-floor office overlooking the lit Manhattan skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows. A lone researcher, a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied back, wearing a dark sweater, sits at a desk lit by a single desk lamp, reading printed pages. Slow dolly push-in from behind her shoulder toward the desk. Rain streaks on the window glass.
Extreme macro close-up of a woman's fingers typing quickly on a mechanical keyboard on a desk at night, lit by a single desk lamp from the side, keys depressing, shallow depth of field.

Extreme close-up of a woman's eye, dark hair at the edge of frame, eye moving left to right as she reads, then stopping and narrowing slightly with focus. Warm lamp light reflected in the iris, night, very shallow depth of field.

Macro close-up of a woman's hand drawing a fountain pen line slowly under a row of printed text on a white paper page lying on a desk at night, lamp light raking across the paper. The printed text is out of focus and unreadable.

Early morning, a vast nearly empty open-plan financial office with enormous windows. Long shafts of low sunlight cut across rows of empty desks and chairs, dust in the air. A man in his forties in a white shirt and dark trousers, short grey-flecked hair, walks away from camera toward a single desk by the window. Camera tracks slowly behind him at a distance.

Close-up of a large plain analog office wall clock with a clean white face and black hands, the second hand stepping tick by tick. Static locked-off camera, morning window light casting a soft shadow across the wall.

Top-down overhead shot of a man's hands opening a thick bound printed financial report on a wooden desk in morning sunlight, heavy pages falling open, a pencil and a mechanical watch on the desk beside it. Text on pages soft and unreadable.

Extreme macro close-up of a man's index finger slowly tracing along a single line of small printed text on a paper page, morning side light grazing the paper fibers, very shallow depth of field, text out of focus.
Extreme macro close-up of a sharpened graphite pencil tip touching down onto white paper and making a small tick mark, paper grain visible, morning raking light, slow motion.
Extreme macro close-up inside an open-caseback mechanical watch movement: the balance wheel oscillating, tiny gears and jewels turning, polished steel highlights. Slow push-in.

Extreme close-up of a man's face in his forties, grey-flecked stubble, eyes looking down reading, light from a window on one side and deep shadow on the other. His eyes move across lines, then focus. Very slow push-in.

Wide dramatic composition from a low angle: a man in a white shirt sits alone at a desk by a huge window in an empty office, two printed documents laid open side by side in front of him, he looks from one to the other. Strong backlight from the window, long shadows across the floor. Slow lateral dolly.
Macro close-up of a man's hand dragging a highlighter marker steadily across a line of printed text on a page, the ink stroke leaving a translucent band, text unreadable and soft, morning light.

Extreme close-up of a man's eyes, grey-flecked eyebrows, perfectly still, a slow realization, the pupils focus and he barely breathes. Hard window light cuts across the eyes, the rest in shadow. Almost imperceptible push-in.

Handheld camera rushing through a packed 1970s stock exchange trading floor at peak chaos, traders in jackets crowding together, arms raised, paper slips flying, one trader in the foreground shouting with open mouth toward another. Fast energetic movement, overhead fluorescent and hanging lights.
Close-up of a trader's hand slamming a heavy vintage telephone receiver down onto its cradle on a cluttered desk covered with paper slips, papers jump with the impact. Hard light, fast motion.

Medium close-up on a 1970s trading floor: a trader in his thirties with loosened tie and sweat on his brow turns his head sharply and looks straight into the camera lens, intense stare, crowd blurred behind him.

Fast moving shot along a newspaper production line: freshly printed folded newspapers racing along an overhead conveyor in a printing plant, rapid repetitive motion, steel machinery, industrial lights.

Close-up of crowded Manhattan sidewalk at rush hour, daytime, legs and briefcases of office workers in coats striding fast past camera, long shadows, sunlight between skyscrapers. Low camera angle, motion blur.
Looking straight up at a towering Manhattan glass and stone office building exterior, clouds racing overhead, camera slowly rotating as it tilts up. Strong sun reflections on glass.
A thick printed financial report is dropped from above and lands flat with a heavy impact on a dark wooden desk, papers ruffling, dust lifting in a beam of light. Low angle close-up, slow motion.
Hands of an older man unfolding a vintage broadsheet financial newspaper from the 1970s, paper rustling, close-up, warm window light, newsprint texture, headlines blurred and unreadable.

A quiet modern minimalist financial office at dusk, a single young researcher, a man in his late twenties in a dark crew neck sweater, sits still at a clean desk reading a printed document, city behind glass windows. Static camera, perfect symmetry, deep silence, soft window light.

Close-up over the shoulder of a young man in a dark sweater comparing two printed documents on a clean desk, his finger moving from one page to the other, modern office, soft side light, text unreadable.
